## Summary
- Pin JuliaFormatter to an exact version (`2.10.1`) in the formatter GitHub Action and `AGENTS.md` so formatting is reproducible across CI and local runs.
- Codebase was already compliant with v2.10.1 formatting rules — no source reformatting needed.

See [Pinning the JuliaFormatter version](https://juliaeditorsupport.github.io/JuliaFormatter.jl/stable/status/#Pinning-the-JuliaFormatter-version) for why pinning is recommended.

## Test plan
- [x] `git diff` reviewed — no functional changes
- [ ] CI passes
title: Pin JuliaFormatter to v2.10.1
